source: Big Data Bowl 2025 (2022 season) tracking, 2 week(s) present; plays.csv, player_play.csv, players.csv
units: yards and seconds; depth = yards behind the LOS (positive toward the offense's own end zone); t = seconds after the snap
definitions: from the snap until the first pass_forward / pass_shovel (throw), qb_sack / qb_strip_sack (sack), run (scramble) or fumble, capped at 4.5 s. Time slices: a play is live at t if that event has not happened by snap + t (strictly). Whole-play proximity scans every frame from 0.5 s up to and including the event frame (as bdb2025_pocket.py), capped at 4.5 s. Plays with a handoff, lateral or direct snap before the end are dropped. Geometry, in yards: depth = (LOS x - x) toward the offense's own end zone, so positive is behind the line (LOS = the football's x at the snap). Distances are between tracking centers at 10 Hz. Rushers: wasInitialPassRusher. A defender's blockers: offensive players who list him in blockedPlayerNFLId1-3. Attached: a listed blocker within 1.5 yd of him (also reported at 1.0 yd); detached: has a listed blocker, none within 1.5 yd (not yet engaged, or beaten/shed); unblocked: no listed blocker. Free = detached + unblocked. Tackles: the two outermost OL (roster T/G/C) by lateral position at the snap. Interior rusher: roster DT/NT or lined up between the tackles at the snap; other rushers are edge rushers. Interior push uses interior rushers on the line (within 2 yd of the LOS at the snap) and, for each, his nearest listed blocker at that moment. 2-yd proximity: any defender within 2 yd of the QB (the passer, hadDropback).
caveats: Slices after ~2 s are survivors: only plays not yet thrown/sacked, a selected subset (n and pctOfCohort in liveAtT).
Distances are between tracking centers (shoulder pads); bodies in contact are ~0.6-1.0 yd apart center to center.
Attached is a geometric proxy (a PFF-listed blocker within 1.5 yd), not a block-state label; blockers listed for chips or double teams count.
OL and blocker depth include the voluntary pass set, not only push; blockerRetreatSinceSnap is retreat for any reason.
Depths are from the football's tracked center at the snap; the play-by-play yard line (absoluteYardlineNumber) sits a median 0.34 yd further downfield (losCheck).
Proximity counts the outcome frame itself (as bdb2025_pocket.py); about a fifth of first 2-yd proximities happen on the throw/sack frame (firstAtOutcomeFramePct), so firstToOutcomeSeconds p10 is 0.
Under-center snaps put the QB within 3 yd of the nose at 0.5 s; whole-play proximity starts at 0.5 s as in bdb2025_pocket.py.
Two regular-season weeks only; play-level dependence (several rushers per play) is not accounted for in the shares.
restriction: Primary cohort is dropbackType TRADITIONAL only: scrambles (SCRAMBLE, SCRAMBLE_ROLLOUT_*), designed rollouts, designed runs and unknown types are excluded, which removes most pressure-to-scramble plays (see withScrambles).
